title: Market Meltdown: Why This Bear Bottoms Without the 80% Crash
description:
Bitcoin is down 50 plus percent and the four-year cycle zombies are calling for 32k. I am not buying it. This top never went parabolic (126k, not 200k), so it makes no sense for the bottom to crater like the old cycles. In this stream I break down why these bear markets keep getting shallower, how Michael Saylor sold a fraction of a percent to crack the 116-day channel and then bought 110 million at the lows, the hot PPI and jobs data, and the projects I am stacking through the pain: Kaspa, Bittensor (TAO), Toncoin, ElizaOS and more.
